title: Every Article Deserves a Video: Contextual Video Matching for Digital Publishers
abstract: arXiv:2608.28359v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As digital publishers face the challenge of managing massive content catalogs, the ability to effectively embed relevant video within text-based articles has become critical for both monetization and user retention. However, manual selection is impractical for large scale publishers, especially when navigating their own extensive video libraries or the entire global Dailymotion catalog. In this paper, we present the "Contextual Video Matching" system, a solution that automatically matches relevant videos with text-heavy web pages and articles. By leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and textual embeddings, we provide a scalable solution for publishers to efficiently combine video content with their articles. We discuss in detail the motivations, architecture, evaluations, and deployment of this system within Dailymotion's production environment. translated_title: 每篇文章都值得拥有一个视频：面向数字出版商的上下文视频匹配
translated_abstract: 随着数字出版商面临管理海量内容目录的挑战，在纯文本文章中有效嵌入相关视频的能力对于商业变现和用户留存都变得至关重要。然而，对于大规模出版商而言，人工选择视频并不现实，尤其是在浏览他们自己庞大的视频库或整个全球Dailymotion目录时。在本文中，我们提出了“上下文视频匹配”系统，这是一种将相关视频与文本密集型网页和文章进行自动匹配的解决方案。通过利用大语言模型（LLM）和文本嵌入技术，我们为出版商提供了一个可扩展的解决方案，使其能够高效地将视频内容与文章相结合。我们详细讨论了该系统的动机、架构、评估以及在Dailymotion生产环境中的部署情况。自上线以来，该系统已被数百家出版商采用，显著提升了……
tldr: 该论文提出了“上下文视频匹配”系统，利用大语言模型和文本嵌入技术自动为文本密集型网页和文章匹配相关视频，该系统已在Dailymotion生产环境中部署并被数百家出版商采用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the "Contextual Video Matching" system, which leverages LLMs and textual embeddings to automatically match relevant videos with text-heavy articles, deployed in Dailymotion's production environment and adopted by hundreds of publishers.
